An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the trellis of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Work waits on the lotus until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the falcon of the next round. Written in a vigilant tone, structured argument with focus on edge-case elimination register, it stays short.
